offline_after_an_hour.why: guesses the usual hour before a silent machine counts as offline, instead of 48 minutes

low_under_20_percent.why: guesses a slot is low under 20% full instead of under 26%

coins_over_810.why: off by one: the coin box is full only above 810 coins, not from 810

coins_full_at_900.why: takes the look-alike 900, what the box holds, as the point where it counts as full
